Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Pascal wrote:
> Well, the question is "What happens if you play Revelations of the Sire on your Caitiff, and someone gains control of it (Graverobbing, ...) and plays Shadow of Taint on Revelations of the Sire?"
>
> (or, but that came later, what happens if a former Caitiff's Clan Impersonation burns ?)
>
A former Caitiff burning a Clan Impersonation makes you Caitiff (and Camarilla).

[LSJ 20081204]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> > Malvalvis (caitiff) Clan Impersonates a Salubri, becoming
> > Independent. Later, she burns the Clan Impersonation, becoming
> > Caitiff again.
> ...
> > does she remain independent?
>
> No. She becomes Camarilla. Changing to Caitiff is handled the same as changing
> to a clan.
>
